newVerifiedInformation: Dwain McFarland's 2026 Week 2 Utilization Report, updated Sep. 15 at 6:04 PM ET, confirms Dalton Kincaid's Week 1 role improved to 69% route participation with a 23% target share, 15.8-yard aDOT and 29% air-yard share. This strengthens the role signal but remains a one-game sample.

FantasyPros Week 2 TE consensus, last updated Sep. 15, projects Kincaid for 52.1 receiving yards. A current FanDuel/numberFire page projects 73.66, which is materially higher and treated as an outlier rather than consensus truth. With the public market around 49.5 at standard negative juice, the combined evidence does not establish a robust 4-5 percentage-point fair-probability edge.

Detroit's official Tuesday practice report remains unchanged from the prior checkpoint: Christian Mahogany and Blake Miller were non-participants, D.J. Reed and Juice Scruggs were limited. No later official practice report was available in this run.

Current public Gibbs markets remain around 90.5 rushing yards and 19.5 rushing attempts. Week 1 workload was elite, but the rushing-yard market is above the 87.92 numberFire projection shown on the current FanDuel Week 2 page and Detroit's offensive-line uncertainty remains unresolved. Do not chase.

Josh Allen's current publicly indexed bet365 passing-yards line remains 250.5 with -116 on both sides. Public projection sources are extremely dispersed, including a very high current numberFire output; no stable price-adjusted edge is established.

Dawson Knox Over 12.5 receiving yards at about -114 is being promoted publicly, but Week 1 usage was only 12 routes and one target despite 38 offensive snaps. Projection-only support is insufficient for PRIME to promote the Over.
